renderer_scope: PBR scalar/color family only; foliage review uses CULL_DISABLED in both control and candidate so sidedness is not a comparison variable. No UV, texture, subsurface, transmission, normal-map, runtime-cost, or universal vegetation claim.

intent.woody: Preserve the already-proven sapling woody response as one bounded family candidate across the three current source-owned stylized tree forms, without inventing per-tree color noise before receiving-scene direction requests it.
intent.foliage: Preserve the already-proven sapling foliage response as one bounded family candidate while testing whether woody/foliage separation remains visible across materially different current forms and camera contexts.

provenance.promotion_rule: This family is not justified by scalar reuse alone. It requires retained multi-source structural and renderer evidence against the original proof-only material pair before downstream adoption.

truth_boundary: Bounded three-source look-development family candidate only. Exact source forms remain owned upstream. This does not establish botanical color correctness, per-species material identity, final sidedness strategy, final Art Direction, Environment adoption, target-device runtime cost, renderer equivalence, UV/texture quality, wind/deformation acceptance, CANON, production readiness, or Materials mastery.
